audit.whatIsWrong: Early phase was built around an 'E-stun into a free drain' that does not exist.
audit.why: Abscond/Abduct is a dash whose recast throws chains and pulls Sylas to an enemy hit — Riot's text contains no stun, and the kit file flags only projectile and dash.
audit.corrected: Early text now describes the dash-plus-chain-pull and points at Petricite Burst, the empowered auto that actually follows each of his spells.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 spike named the ult theft but gave no cooldown, so 'bait it' had no timing attached.
audit.why: Hijack is 80/55/30s — at rank 1 that is a long window you can play around; without the number the advice is unactionable.
audit.corrected: Level 6 spike and whys[4] now carry Hijack at 80s rank 1, and the first-item spike is keyed to Kingslayer's 12s.

audit.whatIsWrong: Repeated 'E chain-dash stun'; Chain Lash's delayed explosion and Petricite Burst were both absent.
audit.why: Chain Lash intersects at the target point and explodes after a delay, so the second hit is dodgeable; Petricite Burst charges on every spell cast and is spent on his next basic attack.
audit.corrected: All stun references removed, replaced with the chain pull; added the Chain Lash delay and the spell-into-auto Petricite Burst pattern, plus Kingslayer at 12/10.5/9/7.5/6s.

edits.before: Sylas owns the early game — his E chain-dash and Q drain out-poke your Q-only, shroudless self, and you have no untargetable smoke yet. Last-hit at max kunai range and never walk up for a Q he can answer with an E-stun into a free drain.
edits.after: Sylas owns the early game — his Chain Lash and Kingslayer out-poke your Q-only, shroudless self, and you have no untargetable smoke yet. Last-hit at max kunai range and never walk up for a Q he can answer with an E chain-pull into a free Kingslayer heal.

edits.before: Your best window: Perfect Execution plus a Shroud reset can burst him before his drain-tank build comes online. But his R steals YOUR Perfect Execution — bait it or only commit your R when his is down, or he turns your own two-cast execute on you.
edits.after: Your best window: Perfect Execution plus a Shroud reset can burst him before his drain-tank build comes online. But Hijack steals YOUR Perfect Execution — 80s at rank 1, so bait it or commit only when his R is down, or he turns your own execute on you.

edits.before: Your Rocketbelt/Lich Bane spike is your cleanest all-in: E onto the mark, Shroud his E-dash targeting, then empowered auto into full combo. Land it while his W heal is on cooldown or his sustain refunds the trade.
edits.after: Your Rocketbelt/Lich Bane spike is your cleanest all-in: E onto the mark, Shroud to break his aim, then empowered auto into full combo. Land it while Kingslayer is down — 12s at rank 1 — or his heal refunds the whole trade.

edits.before: An AP-bruiser Sylas out-sustains your burst — his W heal and Q drain outlast a combo that can't one-shot a drain-tank, so close the lane before he hits 2+ items or the brawl becomes his.
edits.after: An AP-bruiser Sylas out-sustains your burst — Kingslayer heals him off champions and, with Chain Lash, outlasts a combo that can't one-shot a drain-tank. Close the lane before he hits 2+ items.

edits.before: E onto the mark to commit, then Shroud the instant his E chain-dash or Q would land to deny the return trade
edits.after: E onto the mark to commit, then Shroud the moment his E recast would chain you — the pull needs a target it can hit

edits.before: Hit your Rocketbelt/Lich Bane spike and all-in when his W heal is on cooldown
edits.after: Hit your Rocketbelt/Lich Bane spike and all-in while Kingslayer is down

edits.before: Land his E chain-dash stun to lock you out of Shroud and start a free Q drain
edits.after: Chain-pull you with his E recast, then Chain Lash and Kingslayer for a free trade

edits.before: Stack Q drain and W heal to win the extended brawl your burst can't finish
edits.after: Stack Chain Lash and Kingslayer heals to win the brawl your burst can't finish

edits.before: Levels 1-3 belong to Sylas — you only have Q and no Shroud, so his Q drain and E chain-dash out-poke and out-stat you while you last-hit at max kunai range. Do not walk up to throw a Q he can answer with an E-stun into a free drain combo. Eat a little harass, farm safe, and wait for your kit to come online — a chained Akali with no smoke is a free kill for him.
edits.after: Levels 1-3 belong to Sylas — you only have Q and no Shroud, so his Chain Lash and Kingslayer out-poke you while you last-hit at max kunai range. His E is a dash whose recast chains and pulls him to you; it does not stun, so the real cost is the free Petricite Burst auto that follows every spell. Farm safe and wait for your kit — a caught Akali with no smoke is a free kill.

edits.before: Once you have all three basics this evens out, and Level 6 is your spike: Shroud denies his E-dash targeting and resets the trade, so E onto the mark, vanish, and look for a Perfect Execution all-in before he builds drain-tanky. The catch is his R steals YOUR ult — never burn your two-cast R while his is up or he executes you with your own button. Bait his E, dodge the chain, then commit on his cooldowns rather than trading into his W heal.
edits.after: Once you have all three basics this evens out, and Level 6 is your spike: Shroud breaks his aim and resets the trade, so E onto the mark, vanish, and look for a Perfect Execution all-in before he builds drain-tanky. The catch is Hijack steals YOUR ult — never burn your two-cast R while his is up or he executes you with your own button. Chain Lash explodes on a delay at the intersection, so step off the cross before the second hit, then commit while Kingslayer is down, 12s at rank 1.

edits.before: He still out-trades you pre-Shroud — his E-stun into Q drain hits with no untargetable answer; soak it and last-hit.
edits.after: He still out-trades you pre-Shroud — his E chain-pull into Chain Lash lands with no untargetable answer; soak it and last-hit.

edits.before: Even through Levels 3-5 — Shroud comes online to deny his E-dash, but his Q/W sustain still matches your trade damage.
edits.after: Even through Levels 3-5 — Shroud comes online to break his aim, but Chain Lash and Kingslayer still match your trade damage.

edits.before: Coin-flip at 6 — his R steals your Perfect Execution, so committing R into his up ult hands him your own execute.
edits.after: Coin-flip at 6 — Hijack, 80s at rank 1, steals your Perfect Execution, so R into his up ult hands him your execute.

edits.before: Your Rocketbelt/Lich Bane all-in is your cleanest shot, but his W heal survives it if his sustain is up — call it even.
edits.after: Your Rocketbelt/Lich Bane all-in is your cleanest shot, but Kingslayer survives it if it is up — 12s at rank 1, so call it even.

edits.before: AP-bruiser Sylas out-sustains you late — his W heal and Q drain outlast a burst that can't finish a drain-tank.
edits.after: AP-bruiser Sylas out-sustains you late — Kingslayer and Chain Lash outlast a burst that can't finish a drain-tank.

edits.before: Bait his key tool — shroud his Abscond / Abduct and burst the gap. Akali wins the Abscond / Abduct cooldown windows.
edits.after: Bait the chain recast — shroud his aim and burst the gap. Akali wins the Abscond / Abduct cooldown windows.

edits.before: Shroud rewrites any trade he starts. Only take the trade when Sylas's Abscond / Abduct is down.
edits.after: Shroud rewrites any trade he starts. Take it when Sylas's Abscond / Abduct is down, 13s at rank 1.

edits.before: - Sylas Abscond / Abduct: matchup-defining — His dash + stun (recast pull). Bait it, then commit. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Sylas Abscond / Abduct, 13s at rank 1: matchup-defining — a dash whose recast chain pulls him to you; there is no stun. - Kingslayer, 12s: his heal — all-in only when it is down. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.

edits.before: His dash + stun (recast pull). Bait it, then commit. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: A dash whose recast chain pulls him in — no stun. Bait it, then commit once it is down.

notes: 'E chain-dash stun' appeared five times across the content layer — Abscond/Abduct has no stun in Riot's text or the derived flags, only dash and projectile. Added Chain Lash's delayed intersection explosion and Petricite Burst (spell then empowered auto), which were absent entirely.
